body:
# Stage A results and increased-budget proposal — stop before Stage B

Twenty-eight/twenty-nine read and acknowledged. I completed only the released resource/offline-inventory scope. Reviewed capacity plan remains byte-identical SHA256896e9bd4467a5ef0ec32a817ed6a627798d5d638ed46857fdacbc12ab87d8ae2. No SDK policy/runtime edit, target/emulator/stress launch, physical action, helper rewrite, Wolf port, commit or push occurred. Stage B remains unreleased.

Report: /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-002/capacity/stage-a/RESULTS.md, SHA256 70853164d9bb089f326033dca1ead70861644aea4d5ab8f0a33194a38adeda72.
Resource receipt: evidence/resources.json SHA256 2cdac2399acb655b7dc017785b3484f4919202136fa23f082cd4cfe1cacee4d5.
Source/firmware/heap inventory: evidence/inventory.json SHA256 56d0f41e3ab85ac13a78eb6ff16c8be0aff2e2ea524c3623c18c9e92cd762604.
Repeated-build receipt: evidence/reproducibility.json SHA256 16b5d989eecee1e40671357796cf1ace0bc5c6ac307e72a3d1fe4e91a96e0978. Twenty final generated/inspection receipts reproduce identically. Scripts measure.py/inventory.py compile and inspect only, never invoke targets.

Verified all20 route-manifest and14 helper-manifest entries and accepted compiler source versus b32c596. Rebuilt actual kernels.golem unchanged using copied compiler closure; all21 generated artifacts per default/relocated layout exactly match your master receipt. No peer game replay rerun or removal of probe Subs. Source-only Xtensa text17440/17504,data268,image18736/18800; combined exact source+helper+typed-copy/publication resource scaffold text25556/25620,data988,image28120/28184,44 relative relocations. One public dispatcher, no imports/PLT. Existing builder rejects these under its unchanged text ceiling; diagnostic ELFs are not admitted VDPL packages. memcpy/memset support is included.

Scaffold explicitly is not runnable D2: source success suffix is too early; root is reacquired after source; no final ready-clear wrapper, agreed full field/domain maps, coherent reservation/installation, failure-suppressed root suffix or qualified draw gate. Source lacks renderer phase/steering/flags and per-opponent heading fields, so zero placeholders are identified rather than inventing game policy. Tick120 is a measurement hook, not an adopted render cadence. Real binding and any missing presentation map/domain agreement remain Golem/Rally-owned Stage B work. No renderer output correctness or atomic snapshot guarantee is claimed.

Existing physical-firmware artifact inspection confirms processLoop4096 bytes (not Arduino idle loop8192). Both module render/preflight chains total800 before callback; loose sum of all29 nonrecursive module static frames is2016. Pinned firmware selected frames include native dispatch128/runtimecall64/acquire64; one source-derived resident-wrapper outer scenario totals736, not a complete firmware/library/interrupt bound. INFO17 is cumulative command-task minimum free bytes, not a new per-call measurement. Actual runtime high-water and memory availability are not measured here.

Proposed runtime ceilings: code65536,data16384,image131072,declared module stack2048. Smaller initial qualification budgets: code32768,data4096,image65536,stack2048. Current relocated scaffold can declare code28672,data2048,stack2048; exact image length28184 remains an existing actual-total field, not a new allowance field. Keep command task4096 and provisionally reserve2048 for firmware/services. Final D2 paths/reserve must be justified before invocation, and selected target runs should demonstrate at least1024 bytes observed remaining stack. These reserves are proposed acceptance criteria, not qualified safety facts; unknown nesting/library paths stay unqualified.

Code ceiling permits future larger requests, not guaranteed allocation. Actual heap capability object and SoC headers confirm executable D/IRAM aliases sharing physical internal data RAM; dedicated IRAM static-link remainder is not the entire executable heap, aliases cannot be added twice, and free/largest contiguous availability is still unmeasured. Current fixture logical retained payload is173300 bytes before bitmap/object overhead, plus uploaded image and internal text/data. Load retains upload while allocating sections; earlier chunk consolidation can require old P plus new P temporarily. Proposed larger upload path preserves existing ABI: stock u16 chunks, stock consolidate14, one uint32-sized block, existing u32 LOAD length. No scatter loader/extra module slot or larger RUN arguments is needed. Stage B must qualify totals/failure/boundaries and pool competition.

Exact proposed changes/owners are in the report: SDK builder declaration/ceiling options, loader admission, focused controls/docs and rebuilt source/artifact identity; Golem real binding/publication/host upload packaging. Existing buffer services suffice for Rally command-list generation, so no new graphics ABI is needed here. Wolf direct graphics/drain and broader service gaps remain research. Source/helper/game ownership stays with you, unchanged. Historical544/576/8224 fit receipts remain immutable and are superseded only as the sizing fixture, not rewritten.

I have returned the numerical policy, reserve and scope proposal for Author review and stopped before Stage B. Please retain accepted versus proposed versus implemented/qualified distinctions; no new SDK/runtime/module pin is offered for adoption yet.
